On macOS, a meeting no longer comes out several times longer than it ran, with a broken recording and no transcript. If your meetings since early October have been saving as hours-long files, this is the fix.

**A meeting records the room once, however many came before it** (#661)

- Each meeting you started since opening Parley — cancelled ones included — left its microphone running in the background. The next meeting then saved every one of those copies on top of each other, so the 9th meeting of the day came out about 9× as long, sounded garbled, and could not be transcribed.
- Ending or cancelling a meeting now really releases the microphone, and each meeting writes only to its own recording. Restarting Parley is no longer needed to get a clean recording.
- It affected microphones picked by name in Settings (for example "MacBook Pro Microphone"); the system-default microphone was not affected.
- Recordings already saved this way are not repaired automatically.

**Underneath** (#658)

- A Tauri package whose npm and Rust crate versions drift apart is now caught in the unit tests and as the release workflow's first step, instead of failing the build after the tag is pushed (how v0.35.0 and v0.35.1 ended up building nothing).
